discoveredAssets: localhost:32768 - Apache/2.4.65 web server - Port 32768, returns HTTP 404 for all paths

targets.objective: Investigate why all HTTP requests return 404 Not Found to determine if this is intentional application behavior, misconfiguration, or a deliberate test scenario
targets.rationale: The application returns identical HTTP 404 responses for ALL requested paths regardless of URL. Potential security testing scenarios: (1) Verify if this is intentional behavior (application not deployed), (2) Test for HTTP method-based bypasses (OPTIONS, TRACE, CONNECT), (3) Investigate if alternative ports or protocols might be available (HTTPS, WebSockets), (4) Check for hidden file/directory access patterns, (5) Attempt to trigger different error responses through malformed requests, (6) Verify if response body analysis reveals any information disclosure, (7) Test for response header-based vulnerabilities

keyFindings: [INFO] Apache/2.4.65 (Debian) web server running on port 32768

[INFO] No API documentation, configuration files, or sensitive files accessible
